info.name: Group 1 – Enrollment & Records API
info.description:
REST API of the University Enrollment & Records System (WMA4 final project, Group 1).

**Before running:** start MySQL, import `backend/database/schema.sql`, run `backend/database/seed_users.php`, and start the app with `php -S localhost:8000 -t public public/router.php`.

**How to run:** open the collection, click *Run*, keep the order, and run all requests. The Authentication folder saves a token per role in the collection variables; later requests use them. The Create request picks a random test student ID (`2099-xxxxx`) and the Delete folder removes that student again, so the database ends as it started.

**Response envelope:** every JSON response is `{ success, data, message, errors, meta }`. `errors` lists messages per field on 422.

**Roles:** admin = everything; registrar = view, add, edit; faculty = view only.

Full documentation: `docs/api.md`.

item.name: 1. Authentication
item.description: Token sign-in for API clients. Tokens last 8 hours; only their SHA-256 hash is stored on the server.

request.description: Signs in as the demo admin and saves the returned bearer token in the collection variable `adminToken`. Run this before the other requests.
Signs in as the demo registrar and saves the returned bearer token in the collection variable `registrarToken`. Run this before the other requests.
Signs in as the demo faculty and saves the returned bearer token in the collection variable `facultyToken`. Run this before the other requests.

exec: pm.test("Generic message", () => pm.expect(body.message).to.eql("Invalid username or password."));

request.description: Unknown user or wrong password gives the same 401 message, so attackers cannot tell which usernames exist. (Uses a non-existent username so no real account gets locked.)

item.name: 6. Delete student (DELETE)
item.description: DELETE /api/students/{id} — admin only. Removes the test student created in folder 2.

request.description: Only an administrator may delete.
Deletes the student; personal details and emergency contact go with it (ON DELETE CASCADE). 204 has no body.
Deleting again: the student no longer exists.
Confirms the record is gone.

item.name: 8. Reports & Settings
item.description:
GET /api/reports and /api/reports/{type} — admin and registrar (faculty gets 403). Filters: academic_year, semester, program, year_level (empty = all); add format=csv for a CSV file.

GET /api/settings — every role; PUT /api/settings — admin only.

request.description: Lists the six report types, the filters each uses, and (in meta.filterOptions) the allowed filter values.
Enrollments by status and enrolled students by year level for one term. Every report has the same shape: summary (label/value cards) and sections (columns, rows and an optional chart).

exec: pm.test("Every row has a flag", () => body.data.sections[0].rows.forEach((r) => pm.expect(["Full", "Low", "Normal"]).to.include(r.flag)));

request.description: Seats taken per course offering; flag is Full at capacity and Low under 25%.

exec: pm.test("Has the report title", () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include("Student Master List"));

request.description: format=csv returns the same report as a CSV download (Content-Disposition: attachment).
Filter values are checked against the allowed lists.
Only the six types in the catalog exist.
Reports are for admin and registrar only.
Every role can read the default term and rows per page.
Saves the settings (here: the defaults, so the database stays the same).
Only an administrator may change settings.
Each invalid field gets its own message.

item.description: POST /api/auth/logout revokes the token on the server.
